description.narrative: Comunitatea Mea (My Community) is a five-year, USAID-funded program, administered by IREX, that aims to strengthen local government in Moldova to become more more robust,cohesive, accountable, and transparent. Comunitatea Mea strengthens the capacities of Local Public Authorities to: Improve quality and access to municipal services; Increase locally owned revenues and improve financial management; Meaningfully engage citizens in local governance; Advocate for decentralization reform that will.strengthen local governments and communities.
